text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's first three years in the
Twinkle
Series come to an end after
numerous successes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lined up, her trophies already look like
a city
skyline. And her career is far from
over...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, hahaha! I don't hear you
gasping for air,
Cafe, but I don't see you
getting any faster either!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon... I won't lose... I'll surpass you,
and
reach my friend...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While locked in their fierce contest, the
two get
faster and faster, breaking one
record after
another. Until...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before they know it, they're a source of

inspiration for countless runners.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Today's crowd is just as big as the last...
So, what
did you want to discuss?

text_block_list.name: Runner A
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I wanted to ask you about
running on
dirt. Truth is, I'm not very
good at it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Running on dirt? I see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I would say... don't overexert yourself.
Glide
across the sand... like a swinging
pendulum...

text_block_list.name: Runner B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, me next! See, I'm thinking about
becoming a
front runner. Do you have
any tips for me?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A front runner... That's not my specialty,
but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What's important... is awareness... of
where you'll
leave the burden in your
heart. The way you run is
simply an
expression of that idea...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Does that help answer your questions...
at all?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Would you... like to go have some
coffee?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...Sure!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My, oh my. That Cafe makes quite the mentor, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I tend to prattle on and on. But you know what, speed is the name of the game. Speed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that's the crux of my research. I
neither
know nor care about dirt races or
tactics or any of
that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But Cafe brings out the best in
everyone. That
spiritual advice she gives
consistently gets results.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It would seem that, in terms of
versatility, she has
me beat.

text_block_list.name: Runner A
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Cafe, this coffee is so delicious.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Hey now... Don't just guzzle it down in a
hurry.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And it looks like she's having a blast,
too. She's
practically got her feet up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I think I get it. We're different on a
fundamental
level. That's the key
disparity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Manhattan. A place filled with rows of towering high-rises. You'd think from a glance that height was the priority...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But perhaps prosperity was really the goal.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Could I make another request?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try out a new style of running
today. It
might prove useful... for certain
people...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Recently, I've been thinking...
While catching
up to my friend is very
important to me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I also want to keep supporting those
who are
trying to catch up to me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not as fast as my friend... but still, if
I could
help in secret, from the
shadows...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I would quietly hold out my hands... and
be of
support to all Umamusume. That's
my goal...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I see an image overlap with
Manhattan
Cafe's body...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The word "friend" crosses my mind... I've
never
seen her myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My friend? She's here, of course. Right
beside
me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's strange... She was just here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I hear... the voice of her
lineage. The
voice of the Umamusume
lineage itself, passed
down endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's right, she's... She is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a fable about a certain
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That Umamusume boasted almost
unparalleled
speed, and apparently, she
very much resembled
Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps... Manhattan Cafe was dreaming
all
along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dreaming of that unparalleled
Umamusume, who
hoped for Manhattan
Cafe to become her and to
surpass her.
